problem: AI-server boards need laminates with very low signal loss at 112-224 Gb/s.
design: Low-loss crosslinker monomer for PPE/hydrocarbon PCB resins.
name: Low-loss laminate resin

market.what: low/ultra-low-loss resins for high-speed CCL (electronic PPE, hydrocarbon, BMI, active ester, styrenic crosslinkers), world
market.method: PPO 4,558 t x ~$90/kg (SABIC 650k RMB/t) = $410M + hydrocarbon 1,216 t x ~$60-140/kg = ~$120M + BMI/ester/crosslinkers est. ~$170M; check: PPO-for-CCL report $1.2B (all grades); 2026 PPO ~8,000 t x 800k RMB/t = ~$0.9B

value.logic: est.: lower Df (M8 0.0012-0.0016 -> M9 ~0.0006 at 10 GHz) cuts retimers on ~20% of links: 20% x $852M (Astera 2025 rev) = $170M; + Q-glass ($50/m) swapped for NE-glass ($25-30/m) on part of M9 cloth ~ $130M
value.revenue_logic: est.: low-loss resin ~25 kt/yr by 2032 (7 kt 2025 at ~20%/yr); crosslinker ~20 wt% = 5 kt; 5% share = 250 t x $80/kg
value.margin_logic: specialty monomer made by CMO; M9 resin makers report >35-45% GM, prices up 20-30% for AI grades

trend.drivers: AI server PCB 18.7%/yr (Prismark 24-29); AI server CCL 21.4%/yr; PPO + hydrocarbon demand +42% in 2025; 112G->224G SerDes, 800G->1.6T; SABIC outage 2026 doubled supply risk
trend.deadline: M9 boards (1.6T switches, next-gen GPU/ASIC) mass production H2 2026

competition.paper_query: low dielectric loss resin copper clad laminate
competition.notes: SABIC ~70% of e-grade PPE; Chinese makers scaling fast (Shengquan 1.5+2 kt PPO, Dongcai 3.5 kt hydrocarbon line 2026; Dongcai high-speed resin rev 591M RMB 2025, +125%); Thintronics $24M Series A 2024 + up to $50M CHIPS LOI Jul 2026, aims at substrate ILD not CCL

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom: styrenic/vinylbenzyl crosslinker (BVPE/OPE-2St class) from vinylbenzyl chloride + core; 3 variants
lab.test: cure with PPE (SA9000) into plaques; Dk/Df at 10 GHz by split-post resonator (IEC 61189-2-721) or split cylinder (IPC-TM-650 2.5.5.13); Tg by DMA, TGA, water uptake; TAMU iEMSL or Rogers-type test lab
lab.logic: synth 6 wk + cure/plaques 4 wk + tests 2 wk; 3 x $6k CRO + formulation/curing ~$10k + SPDR ~12 samples at $300 first/$200 next ~$3k + DMA/TGA ~$4k

sale.gates: est.: laminate maker prepreg/CCL trial + IPC-4101 slash sheet + UL 94 V-0 ~1 yr; PCB fab + server OEM board qual 1-2 yr
